# ♿ Accessibility Review

## Journeys checked
Start match, select cell, follow cascade, identify turn and finish.

## Review matrix
| Area | Pass/fail | Evidence | Follow-up |
|---|---|---|---|
| Keyboard | | | |
| Focus | | | |
| Screen-reader names/status | | | |
| Non-color identity | | | |
| Contrast | | | |
| Reduced motion | | | |
| Touch targets | | | |
| 200% zoom/reflow | | | |

## Barriers and remediation
Who is blocked, task impact, changes, owners and retest date.

## Sign-off
Reviewer, environment and date. Do not claim conformance without evaluation.
